      @PostMapping("/changeInfo") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<RegisteredUserInfoDTO> changeInfo(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid UpdateFoodieDTO updates)
      Changes the personal information of the currently authenticated foodie.
      Parameters:
      updates - a UpdateFoodieDTO containing the foodie's personal information to update
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing a RegisteredUserInfoDTO with the updated foodie's personal information

      IllegalArgumentException - if the updated birthdate results in an age under 15
